summary: Tested the FX 'Bloqueo por precio extendido' hard gate. Backend: 19/19 pytest checks passed. They cover unit tests of price_action.facts/hard_block (extended move at max_run 3 vs 4, near swing at swing_atr 1.0 vs 0.25, short signal after green candles, too few candles), integration tests of SignalsMixin._handle_signal using a fake engine with in-memory DB and patched open_shadow/evaluate_signal/ai_rules (gate on gives ai_decision=PRECIO_EXTENDIDO, note 'Bloqueada por precio extendido: precio extendido: ...', shadow kind PRECIO_EXTENDIDO and no AI call; gate off sends the signal to the AI with ctx['price_action']; long horizon is never blocked; max_candles=4 is not blocked), and the settings API (defaults, Bybit has no price_action_* keys, pepper PUT does not change the fx bot, 422 validation on both bots, defaults restored). Frontend: on /pepperstone and /hotforex the Filtros toggle goes ACTIVO -> APAGADO, stays APAGADO after reload, then goes back to ACTIVO. The hint shows. In Ajustes the switch and both numeric inputs show 3 and 1. The Bybit dashboard has none of these elements.
critical_code_review_comments: price_action.from_df docstring says `upto` is the signal-candle index (exclusive), but _handle_signal passes upto=len(df)-1 while the signal candle is i=len(df)-2. The closed signal candle is therefore included. That behaviour looks right; only the docstring is misleading.
pa is computed even when the signal is already blocked by an earlier gate. This is harmless (only CPU), and pa is stored in the context for analysis.
seed_data_creation: None. The integration tests use an in-memory fake DB, so no signals or shadows were written to Mongo. Settings on both FX bots are back at their defaults (true/3/1.0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter73_price_action_block.py has a reusable fake-engine harness (make_engine/run_gate) for calling fx SignalsMixin._handle_signal without real I/O. The settings API tests restore the defaults in their teardown.
